title: Coefficient 7/2 with an explicit all-length remainder: C_B2(F_N) >= (7/2)N - E(N) for N >= 16807

claims.statement: Joint CircuitBreaker theorem under rules.md: the following declaration defines ONE fixed eligible total uniform NP family in the pinned full B2 model at actual input length n. Its full guarantee and its declared projection both hold unconditionally, for all sufficiently large integer lengths with the quantifiers specified by the theorem kinds. Both score source claims assert this ENTIRE declaration, not separate lemmas. Let L(n)=c*n^p*(log2 n)^q*(log2 log2 n)^r with the exact parameters in guarantee.leading. Let R(n) be the sum of the monomials in guarantee.remainder.terms, each coefficient times n^exponent*(log2 n)^log_exponent*(log2 log2 n)^loglog_exponent; an empty sum is zero. There exists N such that C_B2(f_n)>=L(n)-R(n) for every integer n>=N. All remainder coefficients are the exact declared constants. claims: Unscored lemma (elimination.md): if f on n bits is nonconstant on every affine subspace of F_2^n of dimension d, then every circuit computing f in the pinned full B2 model has at least (7/2)n-7d gates.

Unscored lemma (proof.md sections 4-5): for every integer N>=16807 the family parameters satisfy k<N, 1<=t<r and k*t>=r(r+1), and d_N=floor(kr/t)+kt+r(r+1)+1 < (1561/300)N^(4/5)+4N^(3/5)+(1/2)N^(2/5)+(17/24)N^(1/5)+2.

experiments.purpose: Supplementary exact checks. Runs the unchanged audit.py (local B2 identities, potential arithmetic, prime-degree irreducibility test, block isolation, family evaluation), then checks with exact rationals that the loss R(N)=(7/2)k+7d_N is below the declared explicit remainder E(N) for every N in [16807,100000] and geometric lengths up to about 1.09e15, and that all guard failures lie below 112. These bounded checks do not establish the all-length statement, which proof.md section 5 proves.
